# Link tracking

3 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/link-tracking` | Read a workspace's link-tracking settings and channel overrides |
| PUT | `/api/v1/link-tracking` | Save a workspace's link-tracking settings |
| PUT | `/api/v1/link-tracking/account` | Set or clear one channel's link-tracking override |

### GET /api/v1/link-tracking

Read a workspace's link-tracking settings and channel overrides

Requires `linkTracking:read`. Returns the workspace settings plus every channel that overrides them — read this to know how a link in a post you schedule will be tagged when it publishes.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace settings and its channel overrides
  - `LinkTrackingReadResult`
    - `workspace`: `LinkTrackingSettings` | null, required — Null when the workspace has never configured link tracking — distinct from configured-and-disabled.
      - `enabled`: boolean, required
      - `params`: array of `LinkTrackingParam` (max 10 items), required — Appended in order. Parameter names must be unique — a repeated name is a 400, not a silently dropped entry.
        - `key`: string (max length 64), required — utm_source / pk_source style key.
        - `value`: string (max length 256), required — May reference {{platform}} and {{campaign}}, resolved per post at publish time.
      - `domains`: array of string (max 20 items), required — Hostnames to tag, subdomains included. Empty tags every link. Normalized on save (a pasted URL collapses to its host), so the response is what was stored.
    - `accounts`: array of object, required — Only channels carrying an override; every other channel inherits the workspace settings.
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `platform`: string, required
      - `override`: `LinkTrackingOverride`, required
        - `enabled`: boolean | null, required
        - `params`: array of `LinkTrackingParam` | null (max 10 items), required
          - `key`: string (max length 64), required — utm_source / pk_source style key.
          - `value`: string (max length 256), required — May reference {{platform}} and {{campaign}}, resolved per post at publish time.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### PUT /api/v1/link-tracking

Save a workspace's link-tracking settings

Requires `linkTracking:update`. A full save of the three fields — the settings form always sends them whole, and a partial write would make an empty domain list indistinguishable from an untouched one.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `UpdateLinkTrackingBody`
  - `enabled`: boolean, required
  - `params`: array of `LinkTrackingParam` (max 10 items), required — Appended in order. Parameter names must be unique — a repeated name is a 400, not a silently dropped entry.
    - `key`: string (max length 64), required — utm_source / pk_source style key.
    - `value`: string (max length 256), required — May reference {{platform}} and {{campaign}}, resolved per post at publish time.
  - `domains`: array of string (max 20 items), required — Hostnames to tag, subdomains included. Empty tags every link. Normalized on save (a pasted URL collapses to its host), so the response is what was stored.
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.

**Responses**

- `200` — The saved settings, with domains as normalized
  - `LinkTrackingUpdateResult`
    - `workspace`: `LinkTrackingSettings`, required
      - `enabled`: boolean, required
      - `params`: array of `LinkTrackingParam` (max 10 items), required — Appended in order. Parameter names must be unique — a repeated name is a 400, not a silently dropped entry.
        - `key`: string (max length 64), required — utm_source / pk_source style key.
        - `value`: string (max length 256), required — May reference {{platform}} and {{campaign}}, resolved per post at publish time.
      - `domains`: array of string (max 20 items), required — Hostnames to tag, subdomains included. Empty tags every link. Normalized on save (a pasted URL collapses to its host), so the response is what was stored.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`

### PUT /api/v1/link-tracking/account

Set or clear one channel's link-tracking override

Requires `linkTracking:update`. A null field inherits the workspace value; `params`, when set, replaces the workspace list rather than merging. A null override — or one whose every field is null — clears the row back to full inheritance.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `SetLinkTrackingOverrideBody`
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.
  - `accountId`: string, required
  - `override`: `LinkTrackingOverride` | null, required
    - `enabled`: boolean | null, required
    - `params`: array of `LinkTrackingParam` | null (max 10 items), required
      - `key`: string (max length 64), required — utm_source / pk_source style key.
      - `value`: string (max length 256), required — May reference {{platform}} and {{campaign}}, resolved per post at publish time.

**Responses**

- `200` — The override as stored, or null when cleared
  - `LinkTrackingAccountOverrideResult`
    - `override`: `LinkTrackingOverride` | null, required — Null when the override was cleared — including when every field of the submitted override was null, which is inheritance spelled longhand.
      - `enabled`: boolean | null, required
      - `params`: array of `LinkTrackingParam` | null (max 10 items), required
        - `key`: string (max length 64), required — utm_source / pk_source style key.
        - `value`: string (max length 256), required — May reference {{platform}} and {{campaign}}, resolved per post at publish time.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
